title: AI agent market map
description: A sketch of the AI agent market by layer, top (what people buy and use) to bottom (the compute underneath it). Each segment lists a handful of illustrative players, not every company in it -- this is a navigation aid, not a competitor database or a ranking. A company often appears in, or belongs in, more than one box.
schema_notes: layers[].segments[].items are the top-level examples shown on index.html. layers[].segments[].breakdown, where present, is the same segment split into its own named sub-categories (its drill-down page, linked by `page`); breakdown[].items follow the same {name, logo} shape as the top-level items. `logo` is a relative path from this file's own directory to a PNG, or null if no logo was found.
